title: Afrobeat
tagline: Interlocking grooves carrying music and social commentary.
summary: Afrobeat emerged in Nigeria through the work of musicians who joined West African rhythmic traditions with jazz, funk, and other popular sounds. Long arrangements, layered percussion, horns, and call-and-response vocals create room for both dance and pointed lyrics. The style's history is closely associated with bandleaders and ensembles, and its influence continues across African and global music.

pillars.name: Fela Kuti
pillars.why: Kuti shaped Afrobeat's extended ensemble sound and used its performances for sustained social commentary.

pillars.name: Tony Allen
pillars.why: Allen's drumming helped establish the interlocking rhythmic feel central to Afrobeat.

pillars.name: Orlando Julius
pillars.why: Julius connected Nigerian highlife and jazz influences in work that helped prepare the ground for Afrobeat.
